topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (Z-ONE-3.0 Platform) - Low IPB Lamp Control Commands
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command for controlling the Low Intensity Positioning Beam (IPB) Lamp, including color, brightness, and breathing rate.

column_semantics.Input: The communication interface or source of the command (e.g., LIN bus, RHZCU module).
column_semantics.LIN: Command from the Local Interconnect Network bus.
column_semantics.RHZCU: Command from the Right Hand Zone Control Unit.
column_semantics.LowIPAmbtLampB: Command from the Low Intensity Ambient Lamp Bus.
column_semantics.RHZCU_LIN5: Specific command from RHZCU via LIN5 interface.

core_entities.name: LowIPBLampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the color of the Low IPB Lamp.

core_entities.name: LowIPBLampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the brightness of the Low IPB Lamp.

core_entities.name: LowIPBLampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the breathing rate of the Low IPB Lamp.

core_conditions.name: Color Value
core_conditions.description: Range from 0x00 to 0xFF, where 0x00 means no request and other values correspond to specific colors.

core_conditions.name: Brightness Value
core_conditions.description: Range from 0x01 to 0x64 (1%-100%) for brightness adjustment.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate Value
core_conditions.description: Range from 0x00 to 0x1F, with each value corresponding to a specific breathing rate in milliseconds.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Color
core_outputs.description: The actual color displayed by the lamp based on the command.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Brightness
core_outputs.description: The actual brightness level of the lamp.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Breathing Rate
core_outputs.description: The frequency at which the lamp's brightness changes over time.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Rate Timing
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined rates range from 500ms to 5s, with specific modes for original and new breathing patterns.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the command structure and parameter ranges for controlling the Low IPB Lamp's color, brightness, and breathing rate within the Interior Lighting Sub System. It is used to verify that the lamp responds correctly to various input commands across different interfaces.
